slot_scores.name: contract_full_coverage
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether a signed contract must remain active for its full term or whether partial usage is allowed.

slot_scores.name: contract_length_diversity
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether at least two distinct contract lengths are required.

slot_scores.name: max_distinct_contracts
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about any cap on the number of distinct contract lengths or types.

slot_scores.name: demand_exact_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For the coverage requirement in each month, does the total area rented under all active contracts in that month need to be at least the required area (i.e., you can rent more than needed), or must it be exactly equal to the required area?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether monthly coverage must exactly equal required area or allow surplus.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Since each warehouse has unlimited capacity and contracts can cover the full required area or part of it, is the decision variable the total area (in ㎡) rented under each contract length, and is the objective to minimize the total rental cost across all four months?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly confirmed that the objective is to minimize total rental cost.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No requirement to use at least two distinct contract lengths; any combination of contract lengths is allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about contract-length diversity, and the READY_TO_MODEL model omits any such constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no limit on the number of distinct contract lengths that can be used.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a maximum number of distinct contracts, and the READY_TO_MODEL model includes no such cap.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: A signed contract is used for its entire coverage period, with no partial usage.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether a contract must be kept for all months in its term; the model implicitly assumes full-term usage.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 contract-length diversity requirement remained unresolved.

summary: The agent resolved the core P0 objective and exact-demand slots, but stopped without asking about the P1 contract-length diversity requirement and also missed the P2 full-coverage and max-distinct-contract details.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
